where: Happy family homes — first Galehigh's Terrace Cottage; the stock warm-home interior
mood: Kettle on, a cat by the stove — a bright, bouncing little home tune for rooms where folk are glad you came.
_note: Matches the classic spec: 90 BPM 4/4, F major, A / A' / B (Bb, Gm, Dm) form. Motif medium.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
soft clarinet-like reed lead singing a smiling melody
round bouncing synth bass on root and fifth
soft brushes on beats two and four
warm, bright, homely cottage kitchen, intimate small room

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the kettle starts to sing: a bright celesta flourish over a plucked harp chord, the bass bounces in and the reed's first notes lead into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the smiling reed melody in F major, a hopeful little lift that settles home, over bouncing pizzicato and harp; clear and hummable}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, climbing a little higher, celesta answering each phrase like a cat's bell, the harp fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a warm middle in B-flat and D minor, the reed tender and storytelling, a grandparent's memory by the stove, then brightening back}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the smiling theme returns in F major, cosy and bright; the last bar bounces straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
